# Rule 3.7 Competence is expected within command and security. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• Neither command nor security should be grossly incompetent in their responsibilities. Both roles are held to a higher standard than other jobs and should generally be considered dependable. Command should be role-models for their departments. 

• You should not take direct, unchallengeable orders from people other than your job superiors. 

• You should not knowingly break the law as either command or security, unless permission is given by an admin beforehand. 

• Command staff should be familiar with [textlink="Standard Operating Procedure" link="ALSopCommand"] and follow it to the best of their abilities. Security should understand both [textlink="Standard Operating Procedure" link="ALSopSecurity"] and [textlink="Space-Law" link="ALSpaceLaw"]; security members should follow and enforce both [textlink="Space-Law" link="ALSpaceLaw"] and [textlink="SOP" link="ALSopSecurity"] to the best of their ability. Failure to do so may result in a role ban. - [color=lightgray]Generally speaking, a ban in command will also result in a ban from security for the same duration, and vise versa.
